name: Blue Storm in Spring
source:
After several unexpected storms mark the start of his senior year, Tatsurou Souzaki comes across the Azure Blade. Katana-in-hand, he joins forces with his seatmate, the ever popular Isami Nanichi, to defeat natural-disaster-bringing-demons and restore balance to the world!


[From [url=https://zacbytesgames.itch.io/blue-storm-in-spring]itch.io[/url]]
